evidence.reason: At the current tip, recover_kill_phase still accepts any exit code other than 0 or None. A normal recover refusal that leaves the pending drained record unchanged would satisfy the subsequent record checks, so the test could report an interrupted recovery even if the drain kill hook never delivered SIGKILL. The intended interruption check should require the SIGKILL return code (-9), with the same exact-status predicate applied to the recover-kill runner entry.
